model_output:
```sql
WITH swanton_vt AS (
  SELECT region_name, geometry
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Swanton' AND border_type = 'town'
),
fast_food_restaurants AS (
  SELECT pois.poi_name, pois.geometry
  FROM pois
  JOIN swanton_vt ON ST_Intersects(pois.geometry::geometry, swanton_vt.geometry::geometry)
  WHERE pois.amenity = 'fast_food'
),
nature_reserves AS (
  SELECT pois.poi_name, pois.geometry
  FROM pois
  JOIN swanton_vt ON ST_Intersects(pois.geometry::geometry, swanton_vt.geometry::geometry)
  WHERE pois.leisure = 'nature_reserve'
),
fast_food_elevation AS (
  SELECT AVG(ST_Value(r.rast, f.geometry::geometry)) AS avg_elevation
  FROM fast_food_restaurants f
  JOIN public.dem_us r ON ST_Intersects(r.rast, f.geometry::geometry)
),
nature_reserve_elevation AS (
  SELECT AVG(ST_Value(r.rast, n.geometry::geometry)) AS avg_elevation
  FROM nature_reserves n
  JOIN public.dem_us r ON ST_Intersects(r.rast, n.geometry::geometry)
)
SELECT 
  CASE
    WHEN ff.avg_elevation > nr.avg_elevation THEN 'fast food restaurants'
    ELSE 'nature reserves'
  END AS higher_elevation_category,
  ff.avg_elevation AS fast_food_avg_elevation,
  nr.avg_elevation AS nature_reserve_avg_elevation
FROM fast_food_elevation ff, nature_reserve_elevation nr;
```
